title: Flow loops and quantum groups
summary: This paper connects two seemingly different ways of studying knots: quantum group invariants and the dynamics of Morse flows. For fibered knots, we define a two-variable series invariant by counting Morse flow loops in the complement. This dynamical series is conjectured to agree with the BPS $q$-series of the knot complement, which arises from Verma modules for quantum groups and encodes all colored Jones polynomials. We prove this correspondence for all braid-homogeneous knots.
